summary: Webster Financial Corp. filed an 8-K updating litigation status regarding its pending acquisition by Banco Santander, S.A. Under the Transaction Agreement, Webster will merge into a Virginia subsidiary, then Santander will acquire all shares via a statutory share exchange. Consideration terms are not detailed in this filing. A special stockholder meeting is set for May 26, 2026 to vote on adoption. Webster has received demand letters and three shareholder complaints challenging the deal. Watch for court rulings or settlement disclosures; risk-arb spread will hinge on regulatory approvals and shareholder vote outcome.
